description: This file is a shell script for testing rebase behavior, specifically handling broken or conflicting files during a rebase operation. It includes setup of conflicting branches, conflict creation, failure checks in resolve steps, manipulation of author scripts, and permissions testing related to rebasing in Git.

methods.name: create_conflict
methods.description: Creates a conflict by rebasing branch2 onto branch1 and aborts if it fails.

methods.name: check_resolve_fails
methods.description: Checks that resolving a conflict with a modified file fails during rebase.
